description: This file declares functions related to managing the harvesting status of Neighboring Access Point (AP) on-demand scans in a network device component. It provides function prototypes to set and get the harvesting status, emphasizing its role in controlling on-demand scanning behavior.

methods.name: SetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for neighbor AP on-demand scans. Returns 0 for success, 1 for failure.

methods.name: GetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status, returning true if enabled, false if disabled.
